reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis contains a critical error by invoking Au segregation in an FeNiCrCoCu system that contains no Au, and the claim of 'non-sluggish' diffusion contradicts the well-known sluggish diffusion effect in high-entropy alloys, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The test description lists many analysis methods but fails to specify a clear, decisive criterion for falsification; the 'falsified if' statement is circular and the presence of Au in the mechanism makes the test as written inapplicable to the stated material.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a mistaken composition (Au instead of the actual elements) and proposes a mechanism that contradicts established HEA behavior, so it would misdirect research on this question.
